page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose server instance powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor using the x86_64 architecture. It features 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The system is equipped with 32.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. For local storage, it includes a bundled 402 GB NVMe SSD, while it does not feature any GPU accelerators.

Performance benchmarks indicate strong single-core CPU capabilities, with stress-ng single-core performance landing in the top 25% at 2863.28. Multi-core CPU performance and Geekbench scores are average, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 6895.0. Text processing performance is a notable strength, ranking in the top 25%. However, memory bandwidth is a bottleneck for larger datasets; uncached read-only large block memory bandwidth is weak at 36.05 GB/sec, and large block write bandwidth is poor at 13.63 GB/sec.

This instance is well-suited for workloads requiring fast local storage and moderate compute, such as database operations, web serving, and text processing. Passmark database operations and Redis SET benchmarks show average performance, making it a reliable choice for standard transactional databases. The inclusion of a 402 GB local NVMe SSD provides high-speed local caching and temporary storage, enhancing cost efficiency for storage-heavy, general-purpose applications without requiring external block storage.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose server configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs and 32.0 GB of RAM, powered by an AMD EPYC 9B14 processor on the x86_64 architecture. It features a bundled 402 GB local NVMe SSD for high-speed local storage, but lacks GPU acceleration. Benchmark results show strong single-core CPU and text processing performance, though uncached memory write bandwidth is a relative bottleneck. The server delivers average multi-core CPU performance, static web serving throughput, and database operations. This hardware profile makes the instance highly suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, and database applications that benefit from fast local storage.
